verdict.rationale: Solid's own docs say it is small and completely tree-shakable, compiles templates to real DOM rather than shipping a virtual DOM, and has built-in state management so you don't need a third-party library. Hands-on reports back this up: a 4x smaller rebuilt player, and Solid described as small and easy to inject into other pages. missing for 10: concrete bundle-size figures, explicit documentation of a minimal or zero runtime dependency tree, and any evidence addressing supply-chain risk directly.
